title: koeleria phleoides subvar. robusta
intro: Koeleria phleoides subvar. robusta, commonly known as Koeler's hair grass, is a type of perennial grass native to the mountainous regions of Europe and Asia. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immune-modulating effects. The therapeutic actions of Koeler's hair grass include soothing digestive issues, reducing fever, and alleviating respiratory problems, while also exhibiting antibacterial and antifungal properties. The bioactive constituents of Koeler's hair grass include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
